external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library app or a self-service kiosk.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk personnel who manually manage member loans and account blocks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff members and branches cannot be identified from the history.

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone used to borrow, renew and reserve books.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API through which loans are accessed and changed.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Exposure disagreement: 'The lending API is internal-only.' (Lending service note) versus 'The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.' (Interview transcript, Priya). Authentication is also uncertain: Priya said, 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: The text does not establish whether kiosks communicate directly with the loans database.

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, contact details and borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The interview corrects the older note's implication of two databases: 'We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone.'

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: borrow book
data_flows.description: The app requests a book loan from the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya was uncertain whether the API checks a token: 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'

data_flows.name: renew loan
data_flows.description: The app requests a loan renewal from the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya was uncertain whether the API checks a token: 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'

data_flows.name: reserve title
data_flows.description: The app requests a title reservation from the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Reserving is the same shape, the app asks for a title and the API puts the member in the queue for it.
data_flows.notes: Priya was uncertain whether the API checks a token: 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'
data_flows.data_description: a title and the member's reservation

data_flows.name: scan books
data_flows.description: A member scans their library card and books at a self-service kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning

data_flows.name: send loan
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a loan to the lending API after scanning.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_flows.name: send return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a book return to the lending API after scanning.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_flows.name: extend loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend a loan.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk login; the password is on a card taped under the desk.

data_flows.name: clear block
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to clear a member account block.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk login; the password is on a card taped under the desk.

data_flows.name: mark returned
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to mark a book as returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk login; the password is on a card taped under the desk.

data_flows.name: read-write records
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes member, loan and reservation records in the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks operate and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The interview states: 'Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.'
